11

Fire surround

Preparation is most of the job. Floors and furniture are covered, surrounds masked, so there is no paint on sockets, units or carpets.

  1. A free visit. Paul talks through the project and gives free guidance on finishes, colours and budget-friendly options.
  2. Clean and prepare. All surfaces are thoroughly cleaned and prepared, with repairs made before any coating goes on.
  3. Mask and protect. Floors and furniture covered, surrounds masked.
  4. Spray or paint. The finish goes on and your home is left clean, tidy and beautifully finished.
Finish
Sprayed on site with the room masked and sheeted.
Colour
White.
Area
A fireplace surround.

What Paul takes on.

uPVC spraying is one of the most requested jobs: a cost-effective alternative to replacing windows, doors or a conservatory. The inside of the house gets the same careful preparation.

uPVC spraying

  • uPVC window frames
  • Front, back and patio doors
  • Conservatories and orangeries
  • Garage doors
  • Fascias, soffits and gutters
  • Kitchen cupboards and furniture

Interior decorating

  • Walls, ceilings and woodwork
  • Wallpaper hanging and feature walls
  • Staircases, bannisters and radiators
  • On-site spraying of kitchens, wardrobes and doors
  • Colour consultation

Exterior painting

  • Masonry and rendered walls
  • Windows and doors
  • Exterior woodwork
  • Fences, gates and sheds
  • Fascias and soffits
